items.name: keypoints
items.title: Keypoints
items.description: A titled panel listing the main points an article covers — one bullet per `KeypointsItem`. Usually sits right after the intro.
items.author: pmndrs
items.docs: Renders on stock shadcn tokens apart from `bg-surface-dim`, which is why it depends on `pmndrs/design-system/theme` — MD3 has a surface role shadcn has no equivalent for. That dependency is the design system's whole theme, so installing the block brings its palette and its mono font along. Installing it without that dependency resolved leaves the panel with no background at all, and Tailwind reports nothing.

items.name: color
items.title: Color
items.description: Swatches of the theme's Material 3 color roles, as Material's scheme poster shows them. `Color` is a disc inline in text, or a cell with the role's name on it in the ink Material pairs with it; `ColorGroup` fuses cells into one rounded block, horizontal or vertical, nesting as rows. Takes any role in kebab-case (`primary`, `on-tertiary-fixed-variant`, a custom color), or any CSS color.
items.author: pmndrs
items.docs: Every swatch is painted from `--md-sys-color-<role>`, which is why it depends on `pmndrs/design-system/theme`: its palette defines those variables, and they are the whole of what this block shows. That dependency is the design system's whole theme, so installing the block brings its palette and its mono font along. Without it every swatch is transparent, and nothing reports it. The baked palette `theme` brings has the Material roles and the seven pmndrs colors (`lime`, `teal`, `cyan`, `purple`, `red`, `orange`, `yellow`): any other custom color (`note`, `tip`…) renders once your own palette defines it — compute it from `md3-base` with `customColors`, as `lib/md3.ts` describes. A group has no margin of its own: space it from the page.
